# "walk NODE WEIGHT CLEAR NESTED info INFO TIME IWEIGHT (leaf CLIP | kids N

#   256 frames, 0x80c336e past it, 0x80bd20e at node time 1).

#   DObjAnimMat (quat xyzw, trans xyz, weight) before DObjCalcSkel (after
#   the controller hook), "post I" after. cod2-player-anims.md 11.
